maria-ml: Heads up — we saw a p99 jump in EU traffic after enabling the cross-region fallback policy around 11:30. latency SLOs are fine at p95 but p99 doubled for some tails. thinking this is amplification from fallback bursts + kernel selection mismatch.
kevin-runtime: ugh. do you have a flamegraph or trace? is it KV cache misses or long kernel paths? :thinking_face:
jia-sre: attaching the condensed trace we grabbed from the tracer:```
# trace summary (condensed)
request -> route(fallback:eu->us) -> enqueue -> batch-split -> kernel-select(match:fp16->int8) -> kv-lookup miss -> stall_on_io -> compile-sync
90th: 110ms, 95th: 180ms, 99th: 420ms
```
maria-ml: thx. the interesting bit is kernel-select: some models got routed to int8 kernels not profiled for short contexts, causing compile-sync on first few requests. plus fallback bursts are creating microbatch sizes that exceed the preferred batch shape so batch-split kicks in and we see queueing.
kevin-runtime: that explains the compile pauses. any evidence the KV cache behavior is amplifying it? e.g., cold prefix thrash when routing changes region?
bench-bot: profiler snapshot (auto): 
- sample windows show 47% of p99 events have a prior cache eviction within 30s
- microbatch size distribution during spike: 1=>18%, 2=>22%, 4=>35%, 8+=>25%
- kernel compile time median 210ms (on compile path)
dan-eng: suggests: 1) limit fallback fanout with soft rate limit for 30s after region outage, 2) pin kernel variant for canary traffic so we avoid JIT on first requests, 3) lower max microbatch for fallback routes to keep batching predictable.
maria-ml: proposed quick mitigation for rollout: set fallback concurrency cap + prefer hosted fp16 kernel (already warmed) for fallback routing. can we ship as config change?
kevin-runtime: yes we can change routing policy flags — do we want a canary at 1% first?
jia-sre: canary + an alert rule on compile-sync rate sounds good. I'll add a short-lived SLO alert if p99 > 350ms for 5m post-change.
bench-bot: ran a local replay with fallback shaping + pinned kernels: p99 dropped from 420ms -> 260ms in replay, throughput steady. details: batch-split events dropped 72%.
dan-eng: also want a long-term followup: smarter kernel selection heuristic that considers recent kernel warmness and KV cache hit-rate when choosing kernels for routed requests. open a ticket?
maria-ml: opened ENG-8272 with notes and the replay artifacts. assigning to @kevin-runtime for config + @jia-sre for alerts.
kevin-runtime: will push a 1% canary for fp16 pin + fallback fanout cap in 15m. ping me if anything breaks :thumbsup:
jia-sre: will add the alert and rollback playbook. thanks. :rocket:
maria-ml: summary: immediate = canary config change (fp16 pin + fallback cap). short-term = widen canary + monitor p99. long-term = kernel selection + KV-caching-aware routing. good progress. :white_check_mark:
